Style and Substance

Designed with sports-car looks but with surprising SUV space.

Download EV6 specification Build your EV6

Active Sound Design

Elevate your driving experience with Active Sound Design, offering a selection of distinctive sounds tailored to your vehicle's speed and RPM. Embrace the power of choice and enjoy a personalized journey, unique to each drive (varies by model).

Panoramic Curved Display

Experience beauty and functionality with the dual 12.3" panoramic curved displays, seamlessly integrated for a truly immersive experience. Enjoy high-definition navigation with streamlined controls, designed to enhance your driving experience without distractions.

Fingerprint Recognition

Onboard personalisation at your fingertips — with a fingerprint sensor that allows you to apply your driver setting as soon as you're in the driver's seat (varies by model).

Wireless phone charging

Convenience meets innovation with the EV6's wireless phone charging feature. Located in the front centre console, this charging pad allows you to effortlessly power up compatible mobile devices without the hassle of wires, offering up to 15 watts of seamless charging (varies by model).

  • Rapid acceleration

    The new Kia EV6 promises outstanding performance. Go from 0 to 60 miles per hour in 5.3 seconds.

  • Charge range up to 361 miles*

    Up to 361 miles* between charges.

  • Ultra-fast charging

    The EV6's advanced battery charges from 10 to 80 percent in just 18 minutes (1).

  • Zero tailpipe emissions

    The EV6 is our first BEV (battery electric vehicle) built on a new dedicated EV platform.

*The range was determined according to the standardised EU measurement procedure (WLTP). The individual driving style and other factors, such as speed, outside temperature, topography and the use of electricity-consuming devices/units, have an influence on the real-life range and can possibly reduce it.


(1) In order to achieve the maximum charging speed, EV6 must use an 800 volt electric vehicle charger that delivers at least 260kW of electricity. Actual charging speed and charging time may be influenced by the battery temperature and weather conditions.

Discover the details

Explore a world of refined features, from the sleek allure of high gloss black beltline and door mirrors to the practical elegance of automatic headlight control and LED daytime running lights. Each element meticulously combines style with functionality, elevating every journey.

  • Sleek illumination: Signature lighting that captivates.

  • Daytime running lights with dynamic light pattern.

  • Panoramic sunroof: Expansive views meet open-air Freedom.

  • Smart Tailgate: Effortless access with automatic recognition

  • Artificial leather: Sustainable sophistication meets Eco-conscious design.

  • Generous passenger storage: Cleverly crafted spaces for life on the go.

  • Premium relaxation seats: Recline into luxury with the touch of a button

Cutting-edge sights and sounds

The Kia EV6 sets a new standard in automotive technology with its dual 12.3” curved display, engineered for optimal visibility and user-friendly interaction. This advanced display pairs seamlessly with a state-of-the-art sound system, meticulously crafted to deliver an immersive audio experience that envelops every passenger in every seat.

  • Touch screen control: Dual 12.3” curved HD screens for intuitive use

  • Active Sound Design: Customizable auditory driving feedback

  • Premium 14-speaker sound system: Immersive Meridian® audio experience.

  • Digital Control Panel: Effortless infotainment and climate toggling.

Advanced safety for a confident journey

Journey with confidence in the EV6, made safer with the latest advancements in Driver Assistance Technology. These innovative features work tirelessly to ensure a secure, worry-free driving experience, keeping you protected every mile of the way.

  • Highway Driving Assist 2: Effortless cruising with Adaptive Lane and Speed Control

  • Remote Smart Parking Assist 2: Hassle-free, autonomous parking

  • Head-Up Display: Futuristic integration for enhanced navigation

For a greener future with WLTP

The testing measures for car pollutants, emissions and fuel consumption are changing. The new Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicle Test Procedure (WLTP) aims to provide more accurate comparable vehicle data that better reflects realistic driving conditions.
